title: Unlock Opportunities with DSCR Loans!
subtitle: Empower your investor clients with flexible financing options through DSCR Loans. Structure deals based on property cash flow, not borrower income.
keyTakeaways: Identify existing clients who are real estate investors.
Explain DSCR benefits: no income or employment verification.
Utilize PRO Portal for pricing and documentation preparation.
Verify asset documentation and consider reserve needs.
Broaden your pipeline with satisfied, qualified investors.

sections.heading: Identify the Right Clients
sections.body: Begin by searching your current pipeline for clients with a history of real estate investment and strong credit profiles. These clients are ideal candidates for DSCR loans, which leverage property income over conventional income guidelines.
bullets: Focus on clients seeking to purchase or refinance investment properties.
Highlight the flexibility of DSCR loans to them.

sections.heading: Structure Deals with DSCR
sections.body: Use DSCR loans to structure deals by evaluating the cash flow potential of the investment properties. This approach bypasses traditional income and employment verification, allowing for a smoother qualification process.
bullets: Calculate DSCR using market rents vs proposed PITI.
Consider interest-only payments for higher DSCR ratios.

sections.heading: Utilize PRO Portal Efficiently
sections.body: Leverage the PRO Portal to streamline your loan origination process. Price DSCR loan scenarios and prepare necessary documentation with ease, focusing on market rents and current asset documentation.
bullets: Ensure all asset documentation is up-to-date.
Prepare for reserve requirements where applicable.

metaDescription: Explore DSCR Loans: Qualify investors with property cash flow. Up to 85% LTV, DSCR as low as 0.75%. Partner with UFF today.
